## Live replacement

**Live file swap: none.** rebuilt ROM + normal launch; TAS replays can skin the player with Mesen HD tile packs (tas_sprites) without changing the ROM

**Pick whip: none.** no pick backend; the ghost overlay projects the player box from RAM but is not wired to identify/replace

**Live controls:** ghost_runs (overlay), tas_play (native replay, sprite:/chr: skins)

| PlayerGfxOffset | `0x06D5` | row offset into PlayerGraphicsTable (current animation frame) | proven_read | gbox/ghost_runs.py SMB1 |

## Gaps before a live swap / pick whip

- No live sprite write: tiles are in CHR-ROM and the table/palettes in PRG; ghost_runs says injection needs a ROM patch (OAM rewritten every frame)
- The Sonic build changes PRG tables, so tas.rebind_graphics (CHR-only variants) cannot carry native tapes onto it
- Writer covers only Sonic 2 -> SMB1 player
